title: German Chicken Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish featuring crispy chicken schnitzel with a side of tangy lemon wedges. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Dip each chicken breast in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured chicken breast in the beaten eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
Dip the egg-coated chicken breast in the toasted breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2-3 breaded chicken breasts to the skillet and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the schnitzel hot with lemon wedges on the side.
